svg.text: Zero-knowledge architecture · all crypto in the browser · server stores & serves only ciphertext

text.tspan: • Two master passwords never leave the local device

svg.text: Encrypt / decrypt happens here. Keys live only in memory.
• lines — flat DB, one encrypted record / line
• bak/ — timestamped backups before every write
• HTTP Basic-Auth + CSRF + per-IP rate limit
Never sees passwords, keys, or any plaintext.
② Key Derivation — two passwords → two master keys → per-cipher subkeys
run only twice per record · memoised in _mkCache
③ Payload Encryption — four-cipher cascade (nested layers)
encrypt order shown top→bottom; decrypt peels outer→inner. Inner AEAD layers authenticate; outer CTR layers add cipher diversity.
④ Serpent-256-CTR · nonce4 (16 B) · key←MK2 · unauthenticated
③ Twofish-256-CTR · nonce3 (16 B) · key←MK2 · unauthenticated
② AES-256-GCM · iv1 (12 B) · key←MK1 · AEAD ✓ auth tag
① ChaCha20-Poly1305 · nonce2 (12 B) · key←MK1 · AEAD ✓
token = Base32 TOTP secret → RFC 6238 6-digit code
→ padded to 256-B bucket before layer ① (length-hidden)
final ciphertext of the payload cascade
→ encNameHEX · plaintext name never on disk
④ v6 Record Format — 11 pipe-separated fields (one line in `lines`)
Legend: ■ enc name ■ Argon2id salts ■ AEAD nonces / ciphertext ■ CTR nonces — a 12th informational line-index is appended only in index.html; writes reference records by content, never by index.
↳ stale delete_rec / hash mismatch → 409 stale, nothing written
Side effects: backup → bak/ · rebuild index.html · return JSON
regen=1 mode rebuilds index.html only (no record touched)
🔑 HTTP Basic-Auth on all writes (hash_equals, const-time)
⏱ Per-IP sliding-window rate limit (5 fails / 900 s → 429)
🔒 flock on `lines` across full read-modify-write + rebuild
🚫 deny lines / manifest / kdfparams / part1 / part2 / bak/
a break in one cipher ≠ a break of the vault.
integrity; a wrong password fails the auth tag.
cipher diversity over the authenticated core.
MK1 drives AES + ChaCha; MK2 drives
required to decrypt name or payload.
